sources.author: Abeja
patch_list: Custom start animation and background music
Adds a patch features menu to Game Space settings for importing custom start animation videos and background music. Pressing back while the start animation plays skips it.
Adds a switch to Patch options that disables the vibration played while the start animation is running.
Adds a Game backgrounds option in Game Space settings that resolves official backgrounds from Google Play for every added game. Updates are manual only, so switching games keeps the stock behavior.
Adds a Patch options section to Game Space settings between Other options and About game space, containing all options added by these patches.
Raises the custom watermark text limit from 10 to 1000 characters.
